answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9719 Country: India Title: Regarding eating or chewing tobacco or gutkha Question: Assalam walaikum Janab, The eating or chewing tobacco or gutkha is injurious to health and may cause the mouth cancer and their are many cases in our society of mouth desease. it is in any condition not healthy product it is always ingerious and in our shariyat the activity of producing eating and distributing these product is makrooh that means close to haram and not allowed.Please clarify my query that the producers, distributers of gutkha and tobaco products are damaging the health of humans the damage may not be as big as caused by the sharab but less than sharab definately. the sharab is haram and the money earned through it is also haram and is not allowed in our dini activity or for personal use also. The activity of gambling lottery or matka is also haram because it damages our social life although this activity does not affect our health but it ruins the family life so it is also haram and the money earned by this way is also haram. But unfortunately as on today the major amount of funds for the madarasa,for the tamir of masjid, for organising the dini istema is coming from the producers and distributors of gutkha and tobaco. These madrasa and other activities are accepting the funds from these producers because they have the point that these activity is makrooh and not haram. In Islam the importance is given to the unity of people in dini mehnat. The niyat of individual will be seen by allah and on nek niyat the dini kam is getting progress and it is progressing because the Allah (swt)wants it to be developed and hence we should not be dependent on the major funds received from these peoples. Without the funding from these peoples our dini work will definately go on because we are having the help from Allah(swt). So please kindly clarify me that the income source of money which causes the harm to the human being how it will be acceptable for the good causes for madrasa or istema and for building masjid.or any other god causes. may Allah (swt) help me not to involve my personai intention to target some one to show him down in the presence of other. My intention is only to prevent these good causes from getting the funding from this not allowed activities. Answer ID: 9719 Posted on: May 24, 2022 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 38/29=H/1429) There is no wrong if you convince sincerely with wisdom and politeness according to the rules in loneliness. But, treating something which is not haram with strictness sometimes may cause many other evils greater in magnitude. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
